contract_changes.summary: Model and JSONL output now include cpu_cores with sparse logical CPU IDs and interval utilization states.

contract_changes.name: btop model dump: process ancestry metadata
contract_changes.summary: Model and JSONL output now include each process row's parent_pid and thread_count for process-tree derivation and sorting.

contract_changes.name: btop model dump: lifetime-average process CPU
contract_changes.summary: Process rows now include cpu_average_percent, derived from process ticks and elapsed lifetime, for the pinned CPU-lazy ordering.

contract_changes.name: btop process view sort and local text
contract_changes.summary: The view now starts in CPU-lazy order and cycles all eight pinned sort modes. Live rows resolve the USER label and show an identity-checked bounded command line without reading environ or adding that text to captured observations or dumps.

contract_changes.name: btop model dump: observed CPU telemetry
contract_changes.summary: Model and JSONL output now carry observed CPU package/core temperatures, frequency, and battery status, power, and remaining-time fields while preserving unavailable states.

contract_changes.name: btop CPU telemetry panel
contract_changes.summary: The CPU panel shows observed package/core temperature, frequency, and battery readings from existing rooted system-report readers; live gauge observations refresh on the five-second schedule.

contract_changes.name: btop model dump: wide counters
contract_changes.summary: Network byte counters and process start ticks are emitted as canonical decimal strings so values above JSON exact-integer range remain lossless.

contract_changes.name: btop interval-rate gaps
contract_changes.summary: Missed sample deadlines and coalesced replay intervals produce an explicit gap rate state instead of deriving a rate across an unknown interval.

contract_changes.name: btop process start identity precision
contract_changes.summary: Monitor process identity accepts i64 start ticks through the shared proc-stat parser; system-report JSON v1 retains its existing exact-number bound.

contract_changes.name: btop replay bundle schema 3 captured mount capacity
contract_changes.summary: Replay schema 3 requires bounded observations.jsonl capacity records keyed to each frame and raw mount identity. Schemas 1 and 2 are rejected; replay never queries statvfs on its snapshot tree.

contract_changes.name: btop model dump: storage counters and capacity
contract_changes.summary: Disk sectors and mount capacity bytes use canonical decimal strings in model dumps so signed 64-bit values remain lossless.

contract_changes.name: btop storage observations and rates
contract_changes.summary: Block counters refresh on each one-second sample while mount capacity retains its thirty-second observation time. Disk history requires diskseq and the device number, uses 512-byte accounting sectors, treats in_flight as a gauge, and does not sum stacked layers.

contract_changes.name: btop G4a default panels and retained graphs
contract_changes.summary: The G1 temporary arrangement is replaced by the pinned CPU, memory/disks, network, and process geometry. CPU, memory, network, and temperature graphs retain source-time histories independently of viewport width; missing intervals remain gaps.

contract_changes.name: btop capability-mapped palette
contract_changes.summary: Panel rows use a fixed truecolor palette mapped to the detected truecolor, 256-color, or 16-color depth; NO_COLOR and unusable TERM values omit foreground colors.

contract_changes.name: btop fixed default inventory
contract_changes.summary: All 56 in-scope pinned defaults are named typed constants in one module and are cross-checked against the G0 ledger extraction. The monitor continues to expose no product option or configuration-file interface.

contract_changes.name: btop model dump per-core process and per-interface network metrics
contract_changes.summary: Process rows expose per-logical-core CPU rates, and network model dumps include identity-bound counters and derived rates for each observed interface.

contract_changes.name: btop network interface view and total offset
contract_changes.summary: The b/n keys select name-sorted interfaces with fresh graph history; z toggles the selected interface's displayed counters to and from an offset without changing rates.

contract_changes.name: btop mounted disk panel and default view keys
contract_changes.summary: The memory surface includes mounted-device capacity, read/write rates, and a selected-device I/O graph. The d/i keys hide disk details or select split read/write graphs; in-scope view bindings are fixed and unsupported actions are inert.

contract_changes.name: XSH ARM64 support scope
contract_changes.summary: Project documentation declares ARM64 supported on macOS and outside supported product scope on Linux and other operating systems; internal Linux ARM64 target infrastructure remains unchanged.
